what: REJECTED micro-optimization of flashvsr_sm89_ops/tiling.py::render_tiled (one host buffer per tile, in-place mul/add, cached weight map). Output is bit-identical but it is consistently slower, so render_tiled was left untouched.
method: GPU fake pipe returning a cached CUDA tensor of each tile crop, so the measured time is the download + blend only (no model work). Case 2560x1408, 85 frames, 2 tiles. 8 render_tiled rounds per process; two processes per arm in alternating order (head, patched, head, patched). sha256 over the output bytes.
why_rejected: HEAD wins every round (median +2-5% for the patch, min +6%); the temporary it saves is smaller than this host's run-to-run spread (+-10%). Recorded because a negative result with clean evidence is a result.
